"""Read only post-run metadata; never serialize environment credentials."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from backend.app.config.settings import RuntimeSettings
from backend.app.repositories.postgres import connect
from backend.app.services.llm import OllamaClient

config=RuntimeSettings(_env_file=None)
client=OllamaClient(config.ollama_url)
with connect(config) as connection:
    connection.execute('SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY')
    audits=connection.execute("SELECT event_type,details->>'outcome',count(*) FROM audit_events GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2").fetchall()
    owners=connection.execute("SELECT actor_user_id,count(*) FROM audit_events WHERE event_type='assistant.requested' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC").fetchall()
    commands=connection.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM aiot_commands').fetchone()[0]
    guard=connection.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM llm_memory_guard').fetchone()[0]
    devices=connection.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM devices').fetchone()[0]
    users=connection.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM users').fetchone()[0]
    active=connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE status='running'").fetchone()[0]
    other=connection.execute("SELECT p.envelope->'data'->'health_score',p.envelope->'data'->'rul_hours' FROM aiot_events p JOIN devices d ON d.id=p.device_id WHERE d.mqtt_device_id='private-fixture-1' AND p.kind='prediction'").fetchall()
assert commands==guard==active==0
assert sum(row[1] for row in owners)==14
assert sorted(row[1] for row in owners)==[1,13]
assert other==[(1,2)],other
snapshot={'ollama_version':client.request('/api/version'),'installed':client.request('/api/tags'),'loaded':client.loaded(),'audits':[{'event':event,'outcome':outcome,'count':count} for event,outcome,count in audits],'admissions_per_owner':[{'owner':str(owner),'count':count} for owner,count in owners],'commands_created':commands,'memory_guard_rows':guard,'running_jobs':active,'users':users,'devices':devices,'other_account_prediction_preserved':True}
Path('/evidence/post-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(snapshot,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('Post-run read-only SQL and model metadata recorded.')
